name: @arjanj/loupe
description: Zoomable, Apple-style architecture maps for codebases and multi-repo systems. One self-contained HTML file.
author: Arjan Jassal

scripts.example: node bin/loupe.mjs manifest examples/bramble/manifest.yaml examples/bramble/bramble.tree.json --strict && node bin/loupe.mjs render examples/bramble/bramble.tree.json
scripts.test: node test/pipeline.mjs && node test/escaping.mjs && node test/acceptance.mjs examples/bramble/bramble.html
